The metallic truss structure and the surrounding asteroids on the left and right have drifted noticeably lower in the frame compared to 00:00.
The top end of the right-hand truss structure has moved down toward the middle-right of the screen as the slow downward scrolling continues, while the asteroids on the left have slowly rotated.
